comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
These give no skill boosts, and only require 500 fame to equip. Mysteriously, I'm told they don't currently seem to be sold in the Atlantis item shop, nor are they apparently produced by any recipes. Maybe they'll be added in during a future update.

For the Temple of Poseidon MA version of this item, go visit the Warrior Sandals info page. Cheers.

Fame Source: tyojyuhei.web.fc2.com/dol_leg.html

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: It doesn't seem like it (as of this comment). I did visit the JP UWO servers of Astraios and Eos to use its Japanese name as a search term for their server-wide company shop item search; I found no sandals, but it did recognize them as a valid search term. Interesting.
